titles.romaji: Meitantei Conan: Conan to Heiji to Kieta Shounen
titles.english: Case Closed: Conan and Heiji and the Vanished Boy
titles.native: 名探偵コナン: コナンと平次と消えた少年

description:
Conan and Ran are visiting Heiji and Kazuha in Osaka but while they are touring around they come across a group of three kids that look like Ayumi, Mitsuhiko, and Genta. The group are looking for their missing friend and Conan agrees to help.

(Source: Anime News Network)
